# LoLo Care

> LoLo Care is a marketplace that helps families find and coordinate independent caregivers for flexible, non-medical support at home, with a focus on Raleigh, North Carolina.

LoLo Care supports companionship, meal preparation, errands, transportation assistance, light housekeeping, respite, supervision, reminders, and help with daily routines. It is not a medical provider or an emergency service. Families review and choose caregivers through the platform, and caregiver availability varies.

## Start here

- [LoLo Care home](https://carelolo.com/): Overview of the service and how LoLo Care works.
- [For families](https://carelolo.com/families): Information for families arranging care for someone they love.
- [Find caregivers](https://carelolo.com/caregivers/search): Browse public caregiver profiles and available qualifications.
- [For caregivers](https://carelolo.com/caregivers): Information for independent caregivers interested in joining LoLo Care.
